liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playin' In The Band** (4 reviews): Playin' goes to unusual places for 1973 and reaches a strong peak; Playin' is praised as top-notch, especially if you like it jazzy [8][14][15][18]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The China Cat into I Know You Rider is described as mindblowing [11]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): Corrects a prior review: Dave Mason wrote and sings 'Shouldn't Have Took More Than You Gave', not Steve Winwood [16]
- **Loose Lucy** (1 review): Reviewer calls this the hottest Loose Lucy they have heard [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **crowd & Phil**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [19]
- **crowd, Happy Birthday To Jerry**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]

## The recordings

- **gd73-07-31.aud.weiner.gdADT12.12883.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 28 songs; 212 min; rated 4.72/5 by 18 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience tape has crowd noise but more presence and immediacy than many board recordings from that year; Crowd is clearly audible on the audience recording, and the overall sound is good; Audience recording is considered outstanding, surprisingly good for a 1973 audience tape [8][9][13]
- **gd1973-07-31.fob-aud.willy.8909.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 27 songs; 200 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Left channel problems from 4:54 to 6:41 were fixed by patching in the right channel; A brief left-channel dropout that caused an audible pop was fixed by patching in the right channel; Minor flaws remain: a one-second muffle in Bobby McGee, and static in Goin' Down The Road and Johnny B. Goode [2]
- **gd1973-07-31.133927.aud.moore.berger.flac16**: audience recording; 26 songs; 216 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1973-07-31.133928.aud.moore.berger.flac24**: audience recording; 26 songs; 216 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- At the start, the whole crowd sings Happy Birthday; the reviewer was born that day [10]
- Band took a break after Playin' In The Band; fans up front passed a birthday cake onto the stage [12]
- Crowd singing Happy Birthday can be heard on the recording as midnight approached for Jerry's birthday [12]
- Roosevelt Stadium felt electric when the band returned for the second set [12]
- Reviewer notes the taper Jerry Moore has died; this show and his other recordings remain his legacy [18]
- Reviewer finds the setlist weak for 1973: no first-set jams like Half-Step, Sunshine or Birdsong, apart from one [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-07-31.aud.weiner.gdADT12.12883.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Noah Weiner; source: Audience Recording [1]. Also: Jerry Moore recorded it with an AKG 1000 microphone into a Sony 110 deck onto TDK C-120SD cassettes; Lineage: master cassette to DAT to CD, then EAC and SHN transfer by Noah Weiner [1]
- **gd1973-07-31.fob-aud.willy.8909.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Audio discs provided by Greg Weister; transferred by Willy; source: FOB>CM>C>DAT>CDR [2]
- **gd1973-07-31.133927.aud.moore.berger.flac16**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Rob Berger; source: source: aud cassette master; taped by Jerry Moore; mastered: AKG 1000e > Sony TC-110; TDK c-120sd’s (re-shelled for transfer); Nakamichi Dragon > Benchmark… [3]
- **gd1973-07-31.133928.aud.moore.berger.flac24**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Rob Berger; source: source: aud cassette master; taped by Jerry Moore; mastered: AKG 1000e > Sony TC-110 TDK c-120sd’s (re-shelled for transfer); Nakamichi Dragon > Benchmark ADC1… [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Roosevelt Stadium - Advertising](https://www.dead.net/archives/1973/clippings/roosevelt-stadium-advertising) [20]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Roosevelt Stadium - July 31, 1973](https://www.dead.net/show/july-31-1973) [21]
- Fan art by Bob Morris Grateful Dead: [1973-07-31 Roosevelt Stadium, Jersey City, NJ, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1973-07-31-roosevelt-stadium-jersey-city-nj-usa/) [22]
